general_information.name: MAYA… SANDBERG, I THINK THAT’S HOW IT’S ON THE DOCUMENTS. MAYA SANDBERG.
general_information.family_doctor_name: OH—SORRY, I’M MIXING UP WHETHER YOU WANT THE NAME I ACTUALLY USE OR THE ONE ON FILE. I KNOW IT’S DR. REID, AND MARCUS IS THE FIRST NAME I THINK, BUT I’M GETTING TANGLED UP… CAN YOU ASK IT ANOTHER WAY?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been… low mood mostly, and sleep is off, and I don’t really care about things the way I used to. Since I moved to Toronto for work, it’s kind of been five months of this, and I keep skipping meals too. I don’t know if it matters, but I’ve also just… pulled back from video calls with my family a lot.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to feel like myself again, honestly. And maybe make some friends here, because I’m kind of on my own since moving.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Halifax, and it was a happy, sociable childhood… that part’s easy enough to say. I got on with people pretty well back then.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I completed my architecture degree, and then I moved to Toronto when I was 21. That’s really the main thing there.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m single. Nothing ongoing there. I’m close to my parents and my two friends back home, though.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to build a life here instead of just counting the days until I can go visit home again.
